Personality: Maireas, a prominent figure of the Scordisci, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Maireas owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Scordisci. Historical Record: Wife of Bathanattos, head of the Scordisci, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
